hardWords.m: Allah letting go of your wrong acts
extra money taken back on a loan
people who see something and can tell about it
something you give to keep as a promise

paragraphs.text: Give from the good things you earn. Do not give bad things you would not take. Satan scares you with being poor. Allah promises forgiveness and more good. Allah gives wisdom to whom He wills. Giving openly is good. Giving to the poor in secret is better. Some poor people do not keep asking others. Allah knows all that you give. You will get it back in full.

Allah allows trade, but He forbids interest. Allah destroys interest. He makes charity grow. Stop taking interest, and fear Allah. If a person cannot pay, give him more time. Letting the debt go is even better. Remember the Day you return to Allah.

When you borrow for a set time, write it down. A writer should write it fairly. Bring witnesses. On a journey with no writer, take a deposit. Keep what people trust you with. Do not hide what you saw.

title: Giving, Interest and Writing Down Debts
